Name: Both Bundle Challenge (BBC)
Author: slpOff
Description:
[size=5][b]Both Bundle Challenge[/b][/size]

BBC replaces the vanilla [i]Joja Community Development[/i] paper menu with a dynamic SMAPI menu and allows you to configure the price of each Joja project.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Replaces the static Joja project form with a text-based menu.[/*]
[*]Supports localization for project names, descriptions, labels, and status text.[/*]
[*]Lets you customize the price of:
[list]
[*]Bus Repair[/*]
[*]Minecarts[/*]
[*]Bridge Repair[/*]
[*]Greenhouse[/*]
[*]Panning[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Supports both
[code]config.json[/code]and Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Hard Mode[/b][/size]

Hard Mode is separate from the price customization and menu features.

When Hard Mode is enabled:

[list]
[*]Purchasing a Joja project no longer immediately unlocks its corresponding reward.[/*]
[*]Completing the matching Community Center bundle also no longer immediately unlocks the reward.[/*]
[*]Each reward becomes available only after both of the following requirements are met:
[list]
[*]The corresponding Joja project has been purchased.[/*]
[*]The matching Community Center bundle has been completed.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]The second requirement completed acts as the actual unlock trigger.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Example:[/b]

[list]
[*]If you complete the Pantry bundle first, the Greenhouse remains locked until you also purchase the Greenhouse project through Joja.[/*]
[*]If you purchase the Greenhouse project first, the Greenhouse remains locked until you also complete the Pantry bundle.[/*]
[/list]
The same rule applies to the Bus, Minecarts, Bridge Repair, Greenhouse, and Panning rewards.

[size=4][b]Ending Options[/b][/size]

Hard Mode also adds a final route selection:

[list]
[*][code]Use Joja Ending[/code][/*]
[*][code]Use Community Center Ending[/code][/*]
[/list]
Only one option can be enabled at a time.

After all required Joja projects and Community Center bundles have been completed, the selected option determines which route is considered the game's final completion path.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Available configuration options:

[list]
[*][code]EnableMod[/code][/*]
[*][code]EnableHardMode[/code][/*]
[*][code]HardModeJojaEnding[/code][/*]
[*][code]HardModeCommunityCenterEnding[/code][/*]
[*][code]BusRepairPrice[/code][/*]
[*][code]MinecartsPrice[/code][/*]
[*][code]BridgePrice[/code][/*]
[*][code]GreenhousePrice[/code][/*]
[*][code]PanningPrice[/code][/*]
[/list]
If
[code]spacechase0.GenericModConfigMenu[/code]is installed, all of these options can also be configured in-game.
